"''Then you will ''die''.|Darth Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} A nameless [[Stone|rocky]] '''moon''' not far from [[Jabiim]] was the site of a [[Fight on a barren moon|duel]] between [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[9 BBY]]. ==Description== A [[moon]] in [[the galaxy]] sat not far from{{Databank|barren-moon|barren moon}} the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] [[planet]]{{Databank|jabiim|Jabiim}} [[Jabiim]]. Its barren surface featured [[Unidentified barren moon's dry lands|dry lands]] and a [[labyrinth of rock pinnacles]]. The latter geography featured great crevasses among the [[Stone|rock]] spires. ==History== {{Quote|I have to face him, Master. Whether he dies or I do, this ends today.|Obi-Wan Kenobi reaches out to [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] before his duel with Darth Vader|}} [[File:Acme-IWillDestroyYou.png|thumb|left|300px|The border between the rocky pillars and the dry lands becomes a historic site as Kenobi and Vader face off.]] The moon lacked any kind of name. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|VI|the duel on the barren moon}} [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], having just [[Attack on Jabiim|escaped]] the nearby Jabiim with members of the [[Hidden Path]] network, decided to make his way to the moon, having realized that the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]—who, in truth, was Kenobi's former [[Padawan]] Anakin Skywalker—was more interested in hunting him than the greater Path network. Joined only by the [[toy droid]] [[L0-LA59]], whom Kenobi did not even realize was aboard his ship until landing, Kenobi departed from the Path's [[JT-731 Broadhorn transport]] aboard a smaller craft and landed within the labyrinth of rocky pinnacles. Indeed allowing the Path to escape in favor of hunting Kenobi, Vader followed Kenobi aboard a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] and landed within the dry lands on the border of the rocky network. Spotting his former master outside the rock pillars, the two exchanged greetings—Vader asking if Kenobi intended to kill him, with Kenobi only countering that he would do what was necessary, which was a sentiment that Vader returned—before beginning a [[Fight on a barren moon|historic lightsaber duel]] that crossed from the dry lands into the rocky pillars. Vader initially bested Kenobi before his former master, drawing on his hope for the future, regained his strength and overcame the Sith Lord, damaging [[Darth Vader's armor|Vader's armor]] in the process. In speaking face-to-face with his former disciple, Kenobi was forced to admit that Anakin Skywalker was "dead," cementing the nameless moon's place in history. Kenobi then departed as Vader called after him, making his way to the planet [[Tatooine]] to [[Assault on the Lars Homestead|protect]] the young [[Luke Skywalker]] and then returning L0-LA59 to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] on the planet [[Alderaan]]. Vader himself would leave and report to his new master, the Sith Lord [[Darth Sidious]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|In the script, it just says 'barren moon.' And that could be interpreted in many different ways.|[[Doug Chiang]]|{{HomeVideoCite|set=Obi-Wan Kenobi: The Complete Series|featurette=Duels of Fate: Obi-Wan vs Vader}}}} The unidentified barren moon first appeared in the [[Part VI|sixth episode]] of the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series, which aired on [[June 22]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}} The scenes on the moon were filmed in''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' the virtual LED set{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/obi-wan-kenobi-ewan-mcgregor-hayden-christensen-cover-story|text=Inside the 17-year journey to reunite Ewan McGregor and Hayden
